map.→ 打开快递装箱尺寸校验工具: → Open the Box Fit & Packing Orientation Checker (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.快递装箱尺寸校验器输入物品与纸箱内尺寸，尝试六种摆放方向，判断能否装入、推荐最优: The Box Fit Checker takes item and carton inner dimensions, tries six orientations, and reports whether items fit, the best orientation, maximum items per carton and space utilization—useful for e-commerce shipping, warehouse picking and pre-packing checks.
map.仓储拣货配箱：按订单件数与商品尺寸选箱，避免大箱装小件。: Warehouse picking: choose cartons by order item count and product size to avoid using oversized boxes for small items.
map.填写物品数量、单侧间隙与软包装/缓冲余量；加气泡膜时把膜厚折算进间隙或余量。: Enter item quantity, clearance per side and soft-packaging/buffer allowance; when adding bubble wrap, include its thickness in the clearance or allowance.
map.常见原因是纸箱标注为外径、纸板厚度与压痕占用空间、物品鼓包或缓冲材料回弹。建议按: Common causes are cartons marked by outer dimensions, board thickness and flutes taking up space, bulging items or cushioning rebound. Measure the inner dimensions and leave 5%–10% allowance.
map.把物品的长、宽、高依次对应纸箱的长、宽、高，共有 6 种全排列。对每个朝向计算各: Match item length, width and height to carton length, width and height; there are 6 permutations. For each orientation, compute items per axis: floor(carton length ÷ item length), floor(carton width ÷ item width), floor(carton height ÷ item height), then multiply the three for the maximum per carton. The tool checks all 6 orientations and recommends the one with the most items. Clearance per side is added on both sides of each axis, and the soft-packaging allowance scales item dimensions by a percentage.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入不上传服务器，结果为尺寸校核参考。计算假设规则长方体、同一: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs; results are dimensional checks for reference. It assumes regular cuboids packed neatly in one orientation and does not account for mixed packing, tilted placement, carton inner-dimension tolerance or compression strength. Follow platform packaging rules and weight limits; trial-pack irregular items.
map.查看六种朝向明细，必要时换箱型或调整摆放；导出 CSV 便于仓储配箱记录。: Review the six-orientation details, change carton size or placement if needed, and export CSV for warehouse packing records.
map.点击“计算”，查看能否装入、推荐朝向、单箱最多件数与空间利用率。: Click Calculate to see whether items fit, the recommended orientation, maximum items per carton and space utilization.
map.物品 25×18×10 cm、纸箱内径 40×30×25 cm、2 件、单侧间隙: Item 25×18×10 cm, carton inner size 40×30×25 cm, 2 items, clearance 0.5 cm per side: placed as 25×18×10, each axis fits 1×1×2=2 items, just fitting; rotated to 18×25×10, it fits 2×1×2=4 items, which is better. Item volume 4.5 L, carton volume 30 L; with 2 items, space utilization is about 30%.
map.电商发货试装：判断商品能否装入现有纸箱、最多装几件，减少拆箱重包。: E-commerce trial packing: check whether products fit existing cartons and how many fit, reducing repacking.
map.软包装预留：模拟气泡膜、珍珠棉厚度，提前判断加缓冲后是否还装得下。: Soft-packaging allowance: model bubble wrap or EPE thickness to check whether items still fit after cushioning.
map.量出物品的长宽高与纸箱内长、内宽、内高，注意纸箱要量内径，不要量外径。: Measure item length, width and height and carton inner length, width and height; measure the carton inner dimensions, not the outer dimensions.
map.为什么同一个箱子换个方向能多装？: Why can rotating items fit more into the same carton?
map.纸箱三边长度不同，把物品较短的边对齐箱子较长的边，往往能在该方向多放一件。工具会: Carton sides differ in length; aligning an item’s shorter side with the carton’s longer side often allows one more item along that axis. The tool checks all six orientations and takes the largest count.
map.单侧间隙应该留多少？: How much clearance should be left per side?
map.普通纸箱建议每侧 0.3–0.5 cm，方便取放并抵消纸箱内径公差；加气泡膜或珍: For ordinary cartons, leave 0.3–0.5 cm per side for easy handling and inner-dimension tolerance; when adding bubble wrap or EPE, include the cushioning thickness in the clearance or soft-packaging allowance.
map.算出来能装，为什么实际还是盖不上？: Why does the lid still not close when the calculation says it fits?
map.快递装箱尺寸校验器输入物品与纸箱内尺寸，逐一评估六种同向摆放，推荐同向件数最多的: The Box Fit Checker takes item and carton inner dimensions, evaluates six uniform orientations, recommends the orientation with the most uniform units, and reports maximum units per carton plus space utilization. When one orientation is insufficient, it notes that this does not prove a mixed layout cannot fit—useful for e-commerce shipping, warehouse picking and pre-packing checks.
map.把物品的长、宽、高依次对应纸箱的长、宽、高，共有 6 种全排列。对每个朝向计算各: Match item length, width and height to carton length, width and height; there are six permutations. For each orientation, compute units per axis: floor(carton length ÷ item length), floor(carton width ÷ item width), floor(carton height ÷ item height), then multiply the three for the uniform units per carton. The tool checks six orientations and recommends the one with the most uniform units, but it does not search mixed orientations, tilted placement or irregular-item layouts, so the result is not a global optimum.
map.点击“计算”，查看同向能否装下、推荐朝向、同向单箱最大件数与空间利用率。: Click Calculate to see whether the quantity fits in one orientation, the recommended orientation, maximum uniform units per carton and space utilization.
map.物品 25×18×10 cm、纸箱内径 40×30×25 cm、2 件、单侧间隙: Item 25×18×10 cm, carton inner size 40×30×25 cm, 2 items, 0.5 cm clearance per side, 0% cushion allowance: effective size 26×19×11 cm fits 1×1×2=2 items in that orientation; rotated to 19×26×11 it fits 2×1×2=4, better for a uniform layout. Item volume 4.5 L, carton volume 30 L; with 2 items, space utilization is about 30%. With the page default 10% cushion allowance, the effective size becomes 28.5×20.8×12 cm and the uniform maximum is 3; set the allowance to 0% to reproduce 4, which still only reflects one uniform orientation.
map.工具会遍历六种同向朝向并取最大件数，但不代表混合朝向的全局最优。: The tool checks six uniform orientations and takes the largest count, which is not the global optimum for mixed orientations.
